description: Unit tests for the PacFileDecider component in Chromium, testing PAC script fetching, DHCP fallback, auto-detect, and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: Rules
classes.description: Defines rules for PAC script URLs, including success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: RuleBasedPacFileFetcher
classes.description: A mock PAC file fetcher that returns predefined scripts based on rules.

classes.name: MockDhcpPacFileFetcher
classes.description: A mock DHCP PAC file fetcher that simulates asynchronous fetches.

classes.name: SynchronousSuccessDhcpFetcher
classes.description: A DHCP fetcher that immediately returns a successful PAC script.

classes.name: AsyncFailDhcpFetcher
classes.description: A DHCP fetcher that asynchronously fails.

methods.name: CustomPacSucceeds
methods.description: Test that a custom PAC script is fetched and parsed successfully.

methods.name: CustomPacFails1
methods.description: Test that a failed PAC script download results in an error.

methods.name: CustomPacFails2
methods.description: Test that a failed PAC script parse results in an error.

methods.name: HasNullPacFileFetcher
methods.description: Test behavior when the PAC file fetcher is null.

methods.name: AutodetectSuccess
methods.description: Test successful autodetect via WPAD DNS.

methods.name: SyncSuccess
methods.description: Test that a synchronous DNS success is handled correctly.

methods.name: AsyncSuccess
methods.description: Test that an asynchronous DNS success is handled correctly.

methods.name: AsyncFail
methods.description: Test that an asynchronous DNS failure is handled correctly.

methods.name: AutodetectDhcpSuccess
methods.description: Test DHCP PAC script fetch success.

methods.name: AutodetectDhcpFailParse
methods.description: Test DHCP PAC script fetch failure due to parse error.

methods.name: DhcpCancelledByDestructor
methods.description: Test that DHCP fetch cancellation during object destruction does not crash.
